title: Each Coffee Makes Me TWICE As Fast ☕
description:
At my office, every coffee makes you twice as fast. Most people stop at two, and nobody comes back from ten.

My report was due at five, and my best friend has been too busy for me all year. So I kept pouring.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
